arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS users_with_prepaid_card FROM users u JOIN cards c ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE u.credit_score >= 750 AND c.card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)'
arguments.explanation: Counts distinct users with a credit score of 750 or more who own at least one prepaid debit card.
assumptions: 'Prepaid debit card' is read as card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)'; plain 'Debit' cards are excluded.
Each user is counted once, however many prepaid cards they own.
